verdict.rationale: Grok Bot is documented as AI teammates that do real work on a persistent cloud computer (grok-docs-15), which suggests an agent acting on your behalf in a computing environment, but the evidence never explicitly says it operates a web browser or completes tasks on websites. Multi-agent research (grok-docs-26) covers deep research but not browser control. missing for 10: explicit documentation of browser operation (navigating, clicking, filling forms on websites), details of how tasks are completed on sites, hands-on or independent corroboration of browser-agent use.
